headline: Israel escalates pressure on three fronts while Iran readies air defenses
subheadline: Israeli drone strike in Qabrikha killed Muhammad Nasser Yousef and wounded another, as 124 Red Alert alerts erupted across southern Lebanon.
lede: Israeli forces carried out a drone strike in Qabrikha, southern Lebanon, killing Muhammad Nasser Yousef and wounding another, while IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir warned against Hezbollah establishing terror infrastructure in the area. In Gaza, Israeli strikes eliminated six Palestinian operatives this week, including a top Hamas commander who had held hostage Omer Shem Tov, and Red Alert Lebanon recorded 124 alerts today, with 80 drone alerts concentrated in Nabatieh and South districts. Russian forces launched a large‑scale multi‑axis drone offensive, firing over 50 Shahed and Geran‑5 drones at Kyiv, Poltava, Chernihiv, Rivne, Khmelnytskyi, Vinnytsia, and Kirovohrad, while three KAB bombs struck Sumy's Kovpakivskyi district. Ukrainian UAVs hit an Ozon logistics hub in Adygeysk, igniting a blaze, and targeted three substations critical for Khmelnytskyi NPP, as Russian ground gains continued near Kostiantynivka.

sections.title: Russia launches massive drone barrage across Ukraine
sections.body: Russian multi‑axis drone offensive employed Shahed and Geran‑5 systems, targeting Kyiv, Poltava, Chernihiv, Rivne, Khmelnytskyi, Vinnytsia, and Kirovohrad regions. Three Russian KAB guided bombs hit Sumy's Kovpakivskyi district, damaging infrastructure with no reported casualties. Ukrainian UAV attack ignited fire at the Ozon logistics center in Adygeysk, Russia, with the blaze ongoing. Russian drones struck Kovel substation and three other substations critical for Khmelnytskyi NPP operation.

sections.title: Israel intensifies strikes against Hezbollah and Gaza
sections.body: An Israeli drone strike on a motorcycle in Qabrikha killed Muhammad Nasser Yousef and wounded another individual. Six Palestinian operatives were killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza, including a Hamas sniper cell commander and Nukhba Force company commander. Red Alert Lebanon reported 124 alerts today, with 80 drone alerts concentrated in Nabatieh (56) and South (24) districts. Israeli warplanes and armed Hermes 450 and Heron drones were observed over Beirut, southern Lebanon, and the Lebanese coast, while Iranian air defenses detected jet activity in Dezful and UAV activity in Kurdistan Province.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Israeli military pressure is simultaneously escalating on three fronts: kinetic strikes against Hezbollah in southern Lebanon, systematic targeting of Hamas and PIJ leadership in Gaza, and persistent armed ISR over Lebanese territory including Dahiyeh. Iranian air‑defense posture appears heightened with jet and UAV activity in western and northwestern provinces, possibly indicating alert status or training, coinciding with US strategic assets moving toward CENTCOM and political signals linking Iran policy to electoral outcomes. The convergence of these actions and the narrowing decision window for regional escalation management suggests a heightened risk of broader conflict if diplomatic channels do not de‑escalate tensions.
